fusions.name: Burst Comb
fusions.desc: Flings a spadeful of broken comb as 3 shots spread apart, each dealing 4 poison damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Honey Mark
fusions.desc: You dash up to 6 tiles to the target and strike with the honey-smeared blade for 10 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Overturned Nest
fusions.desc: Turns over a ground nest. The swarm fights for 12 seconds, stinging an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Dawn to Dusk Digging
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
